test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which north bank tributary of the Ganges River comprises of two streams, namely Kaligandak and Trishulganga?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Gandak River.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Chambal** is famous for its **badland topography** called the** Chambal ravines.**
 
• The Gandak comprises two streams, namely **Kaligandak **and **Trishulganga**.
 
• **The Gandaki River,** also known as the** Narayani and the Gandak,** is one of the major rivers in Nepal and a left bank tributary of the Ganges in India.
 
• Its total catchment area amounts to** 46,300 km²**, most of it in Nepal. 
 
• In the Nepal Himalayas, it is notable for its **deep canyon.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Mahananda River** is a trans-boundary river that flows through the Indian states of** Bihar and West Bengal, and Bangladesh. ****​ **
 
• **The Kosi or Koshi **is a** transboundary river** which flows through China, Nepal and India.
 
• **Ghaghara, also called Karnali, **is a **perennial trans-boundary river** originating on the Tibetan Plateau near** Lake Manasarovar.**
